checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Open hands rest beside the body, palms upward.
checks.feet: Supine body rests on mat with straight raised legs supported by a wall.
checks.movement: Lie on back with legs extended against wall and arms resting to sides palms upward. Keep head and torso supported. Eight-second hold with entry and exit omitted. A low head cushion supports a neutral head position.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
